mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies near the Verona Public Library with temperatures at 67 degrees and an air quality index of 52.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students. Designs must be original, exclude partisan themes, and include the phrase I Voted. Submissions are open until July 22 with public voting running from July 28 through August 7.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol, or enjoy live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on July 27 or test your knowledge at trivia nights starting July 28.
Looking at the weekly report, officers handled a variety of calls. Notably, on July 13, a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for an O-W-I after officers found his vehicle stuck on a large rock.
You are going to love today's flavor, Mint Cookie! Culvers is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM today. If you cannot make it, tomorrow's flavor is Caramel Pecan.
